These all sound like "yes"'s to me, but I figured I'd check:
(I ask alot of questions like this, I think)

1) If I have the Info Highway and Ingrid Rossler both in play, can I
"pay 2 to see 2", since I have 8 transfers?

2) With the new !Ventrue, whose name I forget, his ability says you
can spend a master phase action to gain +1 handsize. If I have more
than one MPA, can I increase my handsize more than once?

3) Maris Streck, the CE Malk Justicar, says she can burn a blood to
give +1 intercept to any minion. Can I use this more than once
during the same action?

Thanks.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> These all sound like "yes"'s to me, but I figured I'd check:
> (I ask alot of questions like this, I think)
>
> 1) If I have the Info Highway and Ingrid Rossler both in play, can I
> "pay 2 to see 2", since I have 8 transfers?

Yes.

You can spend 4 transfers to pay 1 pool to draw a crypt card.

Just as you can spend 1 transfer to move a pool to an uncontrolled
vampire.

Each activity may be repeated (as long as you have sufficient transfers)
as many times as you like in each influence phase.

> 2) With the new !Ventrue, whose name I forget, his ability says you
> can spend a master phase action to gain +1 handsize. If I have more
> than one MPA, can I increase my handsize more than once?

Edward Neally.
Yes. He doesn't use the "during X, do Y" template.

> 3) Maris Streck, the CE Malk Justicar, says she can burn a blood to
> give +1 intercept to any minion. Can I use this more than once
> during the same action?

Yes, likewise.
